scope: Proposition 4.1 of the manuscript “The Dimension of the Two-Adic Hecke Algebra at Odd Level” (preprints/The-Dimension-of-the-Two-Adic-Hecke-Algebra-at-Odd-Level-October-5-2026/two-adic-hecke.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 010 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b15081ee4a06c6c6), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 7. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let R be a compact Hausdorff Noetherian topological Zp-algebra, with con- tinuous structure map Zp → R. Suppose a profinite group H has a continuous two-dimensional determinant over R, with trace t and determinant d, and that their values topologically gener- ate R over Zp. Let λ : R → OE be a continuous Zp-algebra map, where E/Qp is finite, and suppose its specialized determinant is that of an absolutely irreducible continuous representation r : H → GL2(E). For x = ker λ, dim Rx ≤ edim Rx ≤ dimE H1 (H, ad r). (4.1)
